eligibility_rule: For target EP(N+1), every candidate input row must have source_episode_max <= N and derived_from_future=false.
prohibited_before_reveal: target/future episode plan or scene plan
thread endpoint/payoff fields whose derivation used target/future episodes
summaries generated with knowledge beyond cutoff
future_safe_transformations: entity alias resolution using cutoff-bounded evidence only
thread-state inference whose every evidence ref is <= cutoff
aggregate statistics that do not encode target-specific future content
fail_closed: Unknown or missing provenance on a field that could carry story information is ineligible, not assumed safe.
